title: Strategy Optimizer to Strategy Challenger
purpose: Run bounded native MT5 parameter optimization, apply deterministic KPI eligibility, and stop after registering a Strategy Challenger.
entry_condition: Owner starts or resumes a validated Strategy Optimizer request.

transitions.action: Launch one native MT5 optimization round
Accept only new/changed compatible MT5 report
Parse passes and apply deterministic KPI gates
Select eligible winner and register Challenger
No eligible winner and round budget remains
Exhaust frozen round budget without eligible winner

invariants: One native MT5 optimization is one Max round.
Strategy Challenger registration is a hard stop; no auto-promotion.
Scientist is only advisory on bounded next-range refinement.
Running request uses frozen values; later UI edits apply only to future jobs.
failure_behavior: Ambiguous/stale report provenance, missing Weighted-R evidence, invalid compile/runtime identity, or registry inconsistency fails closed.
restart_behavior: Resume continues from durable round checkpoints and cannot silently rerun completed MT5 rounds.
rollback_behavior: Failed jobs do not mutate current Strategy Champion or canonical EA authority.
